CREATE TABLE "public"."Appointment" (
  "appointmentDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "clinicId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" text NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "endTime" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'scheduled' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Appointment_status_check_4ddfd9ea" CHECK ("status" IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed', 'checkedIn', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'noShow', 'rescheduled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Bill" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "appointmentId" character(36),
  "clinicId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'unpaid' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Bill_status_check_c777139e" CHECK ("status" IN ('unpaid', 'paid', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Clinic" (
  "address" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "logo" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'inActive' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Clinic_status_check_db0e9a2b" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'inActive', 'suspended'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Doctor" (
  "bio" text NOT NULL,
  "clinicId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "consultationDuration" text NOT NULL,
  "consultationFee" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "licenseNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "specialty" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Doctor_status_check_db0e9a2b" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'inActive', 'suspended'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DoctorSchedule" (
  "clinicId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dayOfWeek" int4 NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "effectiveFrom" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "effectiveTo" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "endTime" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "slotDuration" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startTime" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."File" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "publicId" text NOT NULL,
  "relatedId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "relatedTo" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "size" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MedicalRecord" (
  "appointmentId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "clinicId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "diagnosis" text NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "examination" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "symptoms" text NOT NULL,
  "treatment" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Notification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "isRead" bool NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "readAt" timestamp NOT NULL,
  "recepientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Patient" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "allergies" text NOT NULL,
  "archivedAt" timestamp,
  "archivedBy" text,
  "archivedReason" text,
  "bloodType" text NOT NULL,
  "clinicId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dateOfBirth" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "emergencyContact" text NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "gender" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "last_visit_at" timestamp,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'new' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Patient_gender_check_6679dc61" CHECK ("gender" IN ('male', 'female')),
  CONSTRAINT "Patient_status_check_cbf3b7f6" CHECK ("status" IN ('new', 'active', 'inActive', 'archived'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Prescription" (
  "appointmentId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "medications" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text NOT NULL,
  "patientId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Receptionist" (
  "clinicId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Receptionist_status_check_db0e9a2b" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'inActive', 'suspended'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "avatar" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "firstName" text,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz,
  "lastName" text,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'inActive' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_4e043948" CHECK ("role" IN ('admin', 'receptionist', 'doctor', 'patient')),
  CONSTRAINT "User_status_check_db0e9a2b" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'inActive', 'suspended'))
)
